question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

With cloud streaming, people can play games from a / internet-connected device, avoiding the need for pricey / dedicated hardware such as a game console.

options.text: dedicated hardware such as a game console
With cloud streaming, people can play games from a
internet-connected device, avoiding the need for pricey

solution: The correct answer is** Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"from"** means indicating the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts. (से) • **Example: **She walked **from** her house to the market. • **"an"** is used before words that begin with a vowel sound to indicate one single item. (एक) • **Example: **She brought** an** apple to the class. • Hence, the correct sentence should be:** "With cloud streaming, people can play games from an internet-connected device, avoiding the need for pricey dedicated hardware such as a game console."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: No error** (कोई त्रुटि नहीं): This option indicates that there is no mistake in the sentence. • **Example:** The sentence is **grammatically correct.** • **Option 2: dedicated hardware such as a game console** (समर्पित हार्डवेयर जैसे कि एक गेम कंसोल): This part of the sentence is correct and** does not contain any grammatical error.** • **Example: **Dedicated hardware such as a game console is often expensive. • **Option 4: internet-connected device, avoiding the need for pricey** (इंटरनेट से जुड़ा उपकरण, महंगे की आवश्यकता से बचते हुए): This part of the sentence is also correct and **does not contain any grammatical error.** • **Example: **An internet-connected device is often more versatile than dedicated hardware. 34:Td65, The correct answer is **Option 2)**
